info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Factoring Management API
info.description: The Factoring Management API allows users to modify and manage factoring agreements within the trade banking domain. With this API, financial institutions and businesses can update specific details of existing factoring transactions to reflect changes in terms, itemization, or payment structures. This API is particularly useful for accounting departments and traders who need to maintain accurate and current records in dynamic trade environments. It streamlines operations by enabling updates without requiring full re-entries, enhancing efficiency in managing financial agreements.
